    Richardson Custom Trucker Hats Are a Top Pick

    Custom Richardson trucker hats are known for quality construction, a comfortable fit, and that unmistakable mesh-back look. Whether you're designing hats for a team, promoting your business, or just want a durable hat that fits right, Richardson delivers.

    With popular styles like the 112 and snapback options, these hats are easy to personalize and built to last. Add your logo or message and get professional-looking results without needing to order in bulk.

    Custom Richardson Trucker Hats FAQs

    Pricing for customized Richardson trucker hats is based on the product, quantity, and personalization method. Richardson brand may cost more, but your recipients will appreciate the difference. Our pricing is based on order size, so the price per item decreases as the order size increases.

    This varies per product. We outline the available print locations within our Design Studio. Place your design within the boundary boxes.

    We include free standard shipping with every custom order, with no hidden fees. Delivery typically takes 9–12 business days. If you're on a tight timeline, rush delivery options are also available for an additional cost so you can get your order when you need it.

    We offer no minimums for printed Richardson trucker hats, so you can order as few or as many pieces as you need. For embroidered items, we do require a minimum of 6 pieces for most items to ensure the best quality and value for your order.
